clean_source_blocks.text: There has been a wave of anti-migrant protests in South Africa, some of which have turned violent.
Nigeria has summoned South Africa's acting High Commissioner over a spate of recent attacks on foreigners in the southern African nation.

ABUJA — The Federal Government of Nigeria has summoned South Africa’s Acting High Commissioner following a wave of anti-foreigner protests and reported attacks targeting Nigerians and their businesses in the country.
PREMIUM TIMES reported the violent protests in parts of South Africa targeting African migrants, including Nigerians.
